program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1)]
    col_ranges = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1)]
    counts = Counter(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
                     if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols and v not in sep_colors)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[int(sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) > 1)
             for c0, c1 in col_ranges] for r0, r1 in row_ranges]
'''
